review_findings.summary: recover_pending_publication returns immediately when no PUBLISH_PENDING marker exists instead of recovering an unrelated lower-level release WAL.
review_findings.resolution: Accepted as bounded behavior: GenerationPublisher durably records PUBLISH_PENDING before calling ImmutableReleaseStore.promote, so a generation publication WAL cannot exist without its marker. Direct lower-level store recovery remains the T1 seam.

review_findings.summary: A retained pending intent after an unreconciled publication is reported as a conflict rather than a transient recovery message.
review_findings.resolution: Retained intentionally as fail-closed wording: the pending identity is preserved and explicit reconciliation is required; no generation or evidence is silently discarded.

review_findings.summary: Direct use of the lower-level ImmutableReleaseStore can bypass GenerationPublisher-specific pending admission checks.
review_findings.resolution: This is the intentional private layering boundary: trusted generation consumers use GenerationPublisher and GenerationReadLease; ImmutableReleaseStore remains a reusable release primitive and does not claim generation-policy enforcement.
